image_prompt: A small anthropomorphic mouse with exaggerated Victorian-era gentleman's attire. He has an oversized head with large, expressive eyes that seem to wink mischievously. His fur is a rich brown color, neatly groomed and slightly ruffled. The mouse wears a tiny, well-tailored waistcoat in vibrant purple with gold buttons, a crisp white shirt collar, and a comically large bow tie in canary yellow. Atop his head sits a miniature top hat at a jaunty angle. His whiskers are long and perfectly curled at the ends. The mouse's paws are disproportionately large, adding to his surreal appearance. His expression is a mix of pompous authority and barely concealed nervousness, with his nose twitching slightly. The mouse's tail is unusually long and curled into an elaborate spiral.
